page_title: USA 1-1 WAL | USA v Wales 21/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+10' Kellyn Acosta (USA) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
90+9' Flag up against Gareth Bale (Wales). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
90+5' Joe Morrell (Wales) was too forceful with his tackle and Abdulrahman Al Jassim interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
90+5' Robert Page decides to make a substitution. Ethan Ampadu will be replaced by Joe Morrell (Wales).
90+3' Here's the change. Harry Wilson leaves the pitch and Sorba Thomas (Wales) comes on as a substitute.
90' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.
90' The game is interrupted now, Harry Wilson (Wales) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
89' A great solo run by Brennan Johnson (Wales) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort low towards the middle of the goal was easily caught by Matt Turner.
89' DeAndre Yedlin (USA) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Wayne Hennessey intercepts the ball.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jordan Morris (USA) is coming onto the pitch as Timothy Weah cannot continue after picking up an injury.
86' DeAndre Yedlin (USA) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
86' Kieffer Moore (Wales) commits a foul and Abdulrahman Al Jassim immediately signals a free kick.
82' 1 - 1 Goal! Gareth Bale (Wales) puts the ball into the top right corner past the outstretched arm of Matt Turner.
81' Gareth Bale (Wales) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
81' Walker Zimmerman (USA) brings his opponent down. Abdulrahman Al Jassim has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Wales are awarded a penalty. What an opportunity to score!
79' Substitution. Brennan Johnson (Wales) has come on for Neco Williams.
77' Brenden Aaronson (USA) outjumps his marker inside the box and heads the resulting corner way wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Wales will have a goal kick.
77' Christian Pulisic (USA) prepares to take a corner kick.
74' Substitution. Joshua Sargent makes his way off the pitch and Haji Wright (USA) comes on as his replacement.
74' Gregg Berhalter prepares a substitution. Yunus Musah is replaced by Kellyn Acosta (USA).
74' Sergino Dest comes off the pitch to be replaced by DeAndre Yedlin (USA).
73' A cross by Christian Pulisic (USA) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
72' Neco Williams (Wales) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
69' Christian Pulisic (USA) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
68' Neco Williams (Wales) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
67' Brenden Aaronson (USA) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
66' Here is a change. Weston McKennie is going off and Gregg Berhalter gives the last tactical orders to Brenden Aaronson (USA).
65' The corner is flicked onto Kieffer Moore (Wales), but his close-range header flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for USA.
65' Harry Wilson (Wales) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
65' A header by Ben Davies (Wales) from very close range goes towards the crossbar, but doesn't get past Matt Turner, who makes a brilliant save. It will be a corner kick for Wales.
63' Dangerous play by Yunus Musah (USA). Abdulrahman Al Jassim blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Wales.
61' Kieffer Moore (Wales) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
59' Connor Roberts (Wales) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
58' Connor Roberts (Wales) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
56' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Neco Williams (Wales).
53' Neco Williams (Wales) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for USA.
51' Abdulrahman Al Jassim shows a yellow card to Tim Ream (USA) for a tough tackle.
50' Harry Wilson (Wales) will deliver the corner kick.
50' Aaron Ramsey (Wales) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Wales.
49' Christian Pulisic (USA) sends a long cross over to Timothy Weah, but Wayne Hennessey comes forward to gather the ball.
48' Tyler Adams (USA) is penalised for a foul. Abdulrahman Al Jassim had a clear view and blows his whistle.
47' Timothy Weah (USA) is flagged for offside.
46' Christian Pulisic (USA) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
46' Robert Page has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Kieffer Moore (Wales) comes on the pitch for Daniel James.
46' Abdulrahman Al Jassim blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' The foul by Chris Mepham (Wales) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Abdulrahman Al Jassim.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
44' There's an opportunity for Harry Wilson (Wales) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
41' Christian Pulisic (USA) sends a cross into the box, but Wayne Hennessey comes off his line to gather the ball.
40' Gareth Bale (Wales) sees a yellow card from Abdulrahman Al Jassim after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

36' 1 - 0 Goal! Christian Pulisic displays great vision and sends a pass to Timothy Weah (USA), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the back of the net. The score is 1:0.
35' Tyler Adams (USA) sends a long ball forward to Timothy Weah, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
34' Christian Pulisic (USA) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
34' Christian Pulisic (USA) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. USA will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
33' USA are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

31' Tyler Adams (USA) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Abdulrahman Al Jassim with no other option than to blow for a foul.
30' Sergino Dest (USA) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

29' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Sergino Dest (USA) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wales.
27' Gareth Bale (Wales) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is behind the touchline and USA will take a throw-in.
26' The ball is behind the sideline. Sergino Dest (USA) takes a throw-in.
24' Antonee Robinson (USA) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
21' Antonee Robinson (USA) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
19' Sergino Dest (USA) has proven his good peripheral vision as he picks out Timothy Weah with a lovely through ball.
17' Wales keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
14' Ethan Ampadu (Wales) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar.
13' Weston McKennie (USA) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
11' Today's referee Abdulrahman Al Jassim rightly decides to book Sergino Dest (USA) for his harsh tackle.

10' Joshua Sargent (USA) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the left post! The ball goes out of play and Wales will have a goal kick.
9' The ball is cleared after Christian Pulisic (USA) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The linesman signals a throw-in for USA.
7' Weston McKennie (USA) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Abdulrahman Al Jassim who sees an offensive foul.
4' Christian Pulisic (USA) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
4' Christian Pulisic (USA) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out for a corner. USA can continue in their attacking effort.
3' Christian Pulisic (USA) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
2' Joe Rodon (Wales) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Abdulrahman Al Jassim blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to USA.
1' USA are showing great team-chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly but finally one of the defending players makes an interception.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! USA will take the kick-off.
Abdulrahman Al Jassim will supervise the game today.
